text:
nina_partnerships: Quick pulse  vendors report mixed readiness for the marketplace wave. MI300 customs delay and a Gaudi NIC scheduling bug. Do we split waves or soft-launch?
anna_amd: MI300 pilot boards delayed ~2 weeks. Trying to fast-track one validation batch but not guaranteed.
olga_gaudi: Gaudi runtime patch in review; ETA ~5 business days if CI passes.
rahul_si: SI note: we need hardware to finalize images. Proposal: publish core SKUs (H100/H200/B200) on 2026-06-22 and list MI300/Gaudi as "partner preview". Provide partner-only validation clusters when hardware arrives.
dina_ops: Ops requires SKU IDs + image URIs 72h before publish. If we soft-launch, we need per-region flags and separate release notes.
sam_legal: Messaging guidance: use "partner preview" or "limited availability" and avoid hard public dates. Partner assets must be signed off 48h pre-PR.
release-bot: Event created: "Marketplace core announce (H100/H200/B200)"  2026-06-22  https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/mkt-core-2026-06-22
nina_partnerships: Decision: proceed with core wave on 2026-06-22; mark MI300 and Gaudi as partner-limited preview. Contingency: expand if vendors confirm by 2026-06-18. Owners: comms=nina_partnerships, SI=rahul_si, ops=dina_ops, vendors=anna_amd/olga_gaudi, legal=sam_legal. Post any ETA updates here.
